scripts.vercel-build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); try { if (fs.existsSync('../src')) { fs.rmSync('src_py',{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync('../src','./src_py',{recursive:true}); } if (fs.existsSync('../data/okf')) { fs.mkdirSync('./data',{recursive:true}); fs.rmSync('data/okf',{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync('../data/okf','./data/okf',{recursive:true}); } } catch(e) { console.warn('Sync notice:', e.message); }" && next build
